items.description: Allowed sailors to calculate longitude accurately.
items.impact: Modern GPS builds on the principles of precise location positioning.

items.description: Protected wooden hulls from marine organisms, improving speed and durability.
items.impact: Anti-corrosion technology is used in modern shipping, offshore platforms and even cars.

items.description: The transition from sail to steam engines revolutionised travel and trade.
items.impact: Led to the development of the combustion engine.

items.description: First use of iron hulls for warships, increasing strength and survivability.
items.impact: Led to the development of steel construction, which is standard in architecture and transportation.

items.description: Detailed mapping of oceans for safe navigation.
items.impact: Modern nautical charts and satellite mapping rely on these foundations, supporting global trade and internet cables.

items.description: Enabled underwater warfare and stealth operations.
items.impact: Influenced deep-sea exploration and undersea cable maintenance.

items.description: Introduced turbine engines and heavy guns, setting a new standard for battleships.
items.impact: Turbine technology is used in aircraft engines and power generation.

items.description: Enabled fleets to coordinate over long distances.
items.impact: Led to the development of Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and mobile networks.

items.description: Radar to detect aircraft. Sonar to locate submarines.
items.impact: Radar is used in aviation, weather forecasting and cars. Sonar is used for fishing, oceanography and medical imaging (ultrasound).

items.description: Submarines could operate underwater for months without having to surface.
items.impact: Nuclear power provides electricity for millions of homes.
Further developed and influenced space exploration and satellite launches.

items.description: Integrated digital systems and automated operations.
items.impact: Systems developed are applied in factories and autonomous vehicles.

items.description: Used for surveillance and mine detection.
items.impact: This technology is common in delivery services, agriculture and emergency response.
Protocols developed for defence are now standard in banking, healthcare and personal devices.

items.description: Fuel-efficient engines and waste reduction on ships.
items.impact: Green technologies influence commercial shipping and renewable energy sectors.
